command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
cd /tmp
echo "== fMRIPrep's own output check (.circleci/config.yml check_outputs, 25.2.7) =="
test -s out/sub-01.html || { echo "FAIL: no subject report -- fMRIPrep did not finish"; ls -la out | head -20; exit 1; }
grep -c "Errors" out/sub-01.html | awk '{print "report_error_sections\t"$1}'
# CI: find <out> prune figures/log/sourcedata, paths relative to <out>, sorted; diff vs the committed list
find /tmp/out \( -path '*/figures' -o -path '*/log' -o -path '*/sourcedata' \) -prune -o -name "*" -print \
  | cut -d/ -f 4- | LC_ALL=C sort > outputs.out
LC_ALL=C sort ds005_fasttrack_outputs.txt > fasttrack.out
diff fasttrack.out outputs.out > outputs.diff; RET=$?
{
  printf "expected_paths\t%s\n" "$(wc -l < fasttrack.out)"
  printf "produced_paths\t%s\n" "$(wc -l < outputs.out)"
  printf "diff_lines\t%s\n" "$(wc -l < outputs.diff)"
  nb=$(find /tmp/out -name '*desc-preproc_bold.nii.gz' -size +100k | wc -l); printf "preproc_bold_over_100k\t%s\n" "$nb"
  ng=$(find /tmp/out -name '*space-fsaverage5*_bold.func.gii' -size +10k | wc -l); printf "fsaverage5_gifti_over_10k\t%s\n" "$ng"
  nc=$(find /tmp/out -name '*desc-confounds_timeseries.tsv' | wc -l); printf "confounds_tsv\t%s\n" "$nc"
} | tee smoke-check.txt
if [ "$RET" != "0" ]; then echo "FAIL: outputs differ from fMRIPrep's committed list:" | tee -a smoke-check.txt; cat outputs.diff | tee -a smoke-check.txt; exit 1; fi
# the list proves the files exist; these prove the headline ones are not empty
for f in $(grep -E 'desc-preproc_bold.nii.gz$|_bold.func.gii$|desc-confounds_timeseries.tsv$' fasttrack.out); do
  test -s "/tmp/out/$f" || { echo "FAIL: $f is empty" | tee -a smoke-check.txt; exit 1; }
done
echo "FMRIPREP OK: all $(wc -l < fasttrack.out) paths of fMRIPrep's own CI list, nothing extra" | tee -a smoke-check.txt
